# AI Inference Gateway configuration entry reference

This topic provides reference information for the `inference-gateway` configuration entry. The entry configures an [AI Inference Gateway](/consul/docs/agentic-mesh/inference-gateway): how its policy processor handles errors, how requests route and fail over across model providers, how the processor detects personally identifiable information (PII), and how it exports telemetry.

@include 'alerts/enterprise-alert.mdx'

On Kubernetes, the controller creates this entry for each [`InferenceGateway`](/consul/docs/reference/k8s/ai/inferencegateway) resource. To deploy an AI Inference Gateway, refer to [Install Consul Agentic Runtime Fabric](/consul/docs/agentic-mesh/install).

## Configuration model

The following list outlines the field hierarchy, data types, and requirements for the `inference-gateway` configuration entry. Click a property name to view additional details, including default values.

- [`Kind`](#kind): string | required | must be set to `inference-gateway`
- [`Name`](#name): string | required
- [`Namespace`](#namespace): string | `default` <EnterpriseAlert inline />
- [`Partition`](#partition): string | `default` <EnterpriseAlert inline />
- [`Meta`](#meta): map of strings
- [`Processor`](#processor): map
  - [`FailureMode`](#processor-failuremode): string | `closed`
  - [`BodyModelRouting`](#processor-bodymodelrouting): boolean | `false`
- [`Failover`](#failover): map
  - [`RetryOn`](#failover-retryon): list of strings
  - [`MaxTiers`](#failover-maxtiers): integer | `0`
  - [`PerTryTimeout`](#failover-pertrytimeout): string
- [`RequestTimeout`](#requesttimeout): string | disabled
- [`PII`](#pii): map
  - [`Scope`](#pii-scope): string
  - [`DefaultAction`](#pii-defaultaction): string
  - [`StreamHoldbackBytes`](#pii-streamholdbackbytes): integer
  - [`Mask`](#pii-mask): map
    - [`Char`](#pii-mask-char): string | `*`
    - [`KeepLast`](#pii-mask-keeplast): integer
  - [`Detectors`](#pii-detectors): list of maps | required when `PII` is set
    - [`Name`](#pii-detectors-name): string
    - [`Regex`](#pii-detectors-regex): string
    - [`Action`](#pii-detectors-action): string
- [`Observability`](#observability): map
  - [`Metrics`](#observability-metrics): map
    - [`Enabled`](#observability-metrics-enabled): boolean | `true`
    - [`Prometheus`](#observability-metrics-prometheus): map
      - [`Port`](#observability-metrics-prometheus-port): integer
    - [`OTLP`](#observability-metrics-otlp): map
      - [`Endpoint`](#observability-metrics-otlp): string
      - [`Insecure`](#observability-metrics-otlp): boolean | `false`
  - [`Tracing`](#observability-tracing): map
    - [`Enabled`](#observability-tracing-enabled): boolean | `false`
    - [`OTLP`](#observability-tracing-otlp): map
      - [`Endpoint`](#observability-tracing-otlp): string
      - [`Insecure`](#observability-tracing-otlp): boolean | `false`
    - [`SampleRatio`](#observability-tracing-sampleratio): number

## Complete configuration

When every field is defined, an `inference-gateway` configuration entry has the following form:

<Tabs>
<Tab heading="HCL" group="hcl">

```hcl
Kind      = "inference-gateway"
Name      = "<name of the AI Inference Gateway service>"
Namespace = "<namespace>"
Partition = "<partition>"
Meta = {
  "<key>" = "<value>"
}
Processor {
  FailureMode      = "<closed | open>"
  BodyModelRouting = <true | false>
}
Failover {
  RetryOn       = ["<retriable condition>"]
  MaxTiers      = <number of tiers>
  PerTryTimeout = "<duration>"
}
RequestTimeout = "<duration>"
PII {
  Scope               = "<request | response | both>"
  DefaultAction       = "<placeholder | mask | block | off>"
  StreamHoldbackBytes = <number of bytes>
  Mask {
    Char     = "<character>"
    KeepLast = <number of characters>
  }
  Detectors = [
    {
      Name   = "<detector name>"
      Regex  = "<RE2 pattern>"
      Action = "<placeholder | mask | block | off>"
    }
  ]
}
Observability {
  Metrics {
    Enabled = <true | false>
    Prometheus {
      Port = <port>
    }
    OTLP {
      Endpoint = "<host>:<port>"
      Insecure = <true | false>
    }
  }
  Tracing {
    Enabled = <true | false>
    OTLP {
      Endpoint = "<host>:<port>"
      Insecure = <true | false>
    }
    SampleRatio = <number from 0 to 1>
  }
}
```

</Tab>
<Tab heading="JSON" group="json">

```json

  "Kind": "inference-gateway",
```

## Specification

This section describes the fields you can configure in the `inference-gateway` configuration entry.

### `Kind`

Specifies the type of configuration entry.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String value that must be set to `inference-gateway`.

### `Name`

Specifies the name of the AI Inference Gateway service that this entry configures. The name must match the name of the registered gateway service. When you start the gateway with `consul connect envoy`, Consul reads the entry named after the registered gateway service.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String

### `Namespace` <EnterpriseAlert inline />

Specifies the namespace that the configuration entry applies to.

#### Values

- Default: `default`
- Data type: String

### `Partition` <EnterpriseAlert inline />

Specifies the admin partition that the configuration entry applies to.

#### Values

- Default: `default`
- Data type: String

### `Meta`

Specifies key-value pairs to add to the configuration entry.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map of one or more key-value pairs.

### `Processor`

Configures the binding between the gateway's Envoy `ext_proc` filter and the co-located policy processor. Consul derives the processor socket path for each gateway instance when it starts, so the socket path is not part of this entry.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `Processor.FailureMode`

Specifies what the gateway does when the policy processor returns an error.

- `closed`: Rejects the request.
- `open`: Allows the request through.

Consul accepts the value in any letter case.

#### Values

- Default: `closed`
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `closed`
  - `open`

### `Processor.BodyModelRouting`

Specifies whether the gateway routes on the model named in the request body instead of on a capability header that the caller sends. When `true`, the processor copies the body model to the `x-inference-model` request header, and Consul renders a route for each model that matches that header.

#### Values

- Default: `false`, which routes on the caller's capability header.
- Data type: Boolean

### `Failover`

Configures how Envoy fails a request over across the priority tiers of a capability pool. A capability pool is a capability served by two or more models. This block controls only how failover happens. The Consul catalog decides which models serve each capability and in what order, based on each model service's capabilities and its priority for each capability. Service intentions decide which models the gateway can reach. An empty block uses the defaults.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `Failover.RetryOn`

Specifies the conditions that trigger a retry on the next tier. Set HTTP status tokens, such as `401` and `5xx`, and Envoy reset triggers, such as `reset` and `connect-failure`.

#### Values

- Default: Empty, which uses the default retriable conditions.
- Data type: List of strings

### `Failover.MaxTiers`

Specifies the maximum number of priority tiers that one request can try. The value cannot be negative.

#### Values

- Default: `0`, which allows all tiers.
- Data type: Integer

### `Failover.PerTryTimeout`

Specifies the timeout for each tier attempt, for example `30s`.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `RequestTimeout`

Specifies the overall deadline for one request through the gateway, from when the request arrives to when the response ends, across every failover attempt. For example, `10m`. Consul applies the same deadline to capability routes and to per-model routes.

When the timeout is disabled, `Failover.PerTryTimeout` bounds each attempt and the Envoy stream idle timeout bounds a stalled stream. Consul disables the timeout by default because the Envoy default of 15 seconds can cut off a long completion or a streamed response.

#### Values

- Default: Empty or `0s`, which disables the timeout.
- Data type: String

### `PII`

Configures PII detection and redaction. Consul does not interpret this block. It passes the block to the policy processor through the gateway listener metadata.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `PII.Scope`

Specifies which bodies the detector actions apply to.

#### Values

- Default: Empty, which uses the processor default of `request`.
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `request`
  - `response`
  - `both`

### `PII.DefaultAction`

Specifies the action for any detector that does not set its own `Action`.

- `placeholder`: Replaces a match with `[REDACTED_<NAME>]`.
- `mask`: Masks a match according to `PII.Mask` and keeps its shape.
- `block`: Rejects the request or response.
- `off`: Disables the detector.

#### Values

- Default: Empty, which uses the processor default of `placeholder`.
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `placeholder`
  - `mask`
  - `block`
  - `off`

### `PII.StreamHoldbackBytes`

Specifies how much trailing content the streaming response redactor withholds, so that it catches a match split across chunk boundaries before it releases the content.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Integer

### `PII.Mask`

Configures the `mask` action.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `PII.Mask.Char`

Specifies the character that replaces each redacted alphanumeric character.

#### Values

- Default: `*`
- Data type: String

### `PII.Mask.KeepLast`

Specifies the number of trailing characters that remain visible.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Integer

### `PII.Detectors`

Specifies the PII rules to run. Each rule is a built-in detector or a custom regular expression. At least one detector is required when the `PII` block is present.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required when you set `PII`.
- Data type: List of maps

### `PII.Detectors[].Name`

Selects a built-in detector. With a `Regex`, it names a custom detector in placeholder text and logs. The built-in detectors are `api_key`, `credit_card`, `email`, and `ssn`. The `credit_card` detector also checks the Luhn digit.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `PII.Detectors[].Regex`

Specifies a custom RE2 pattern. This field is required unless `Name` is a built-in detector. Leave it empty to use a built-in detector. Setting it on a built-in name replaces the built-in detector with the pattern.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `PII.Detectors[].Action`

Overrides `PII.DefaultAction` for this detector. Refer to [`PII.DefaultAction`](#pii-defaultaction) for the actions.

#### Values

- Default: Empty, which inherits `PII.DefaultAction`.
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `placeholder`
  - `mask`
  - `block`
  - `off`

### `Observability`

Configures the processor's metrics and tracing. Metrics and tracing are independent and best-effort. A misconfigured or unreachable telemetry sink degrades that signal and does not change the outcome of a request. Consul validates this block when you write the entry, because an invalid exporter endpoint or sample ratio prevents the processor from starting.

The `inference-gateway` configuration entry does not configure a compliance audit trail.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `Observability.Metrics`

Configures metrics export. The processor serves metrics for Prometheus scraping by default. Setting an OTLP endpoint adds OTLP push export.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `Observability.Metrics.Enabled`

Specifies whether the processor exports metrics. An unset value keeps metrics on, so a block that only sets a port does not turn metrics off.

#### Values

- Default: `true`
- Data type: Boolean

### `Observability.Metrics.Prometheus`

Configures the Prometheus scrape endpoint, which the processor always serves at `/metrics`.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `Observability.Metrics.Prometheus.Port`

Specifies the port for the scrape endpoint. Set `0` to turn off the scrape endpoint while keeping any OTLP export. Set a value from `1` to `65535` to move the endpoint.

#### Values

- Default: Unset, which uses the processor's default port.
- Data type: Integer

### `Observability.Metrics.OTLP`

Configures OTLP export for metrics.

- `Endpoint`: The OTLP collector address as `<host>:<port>`, without a URL scheme. Consul rejects a full URL.
- `Insecure`: Sends OTLP without TLS when `true`. Use only in non-production environments.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `Observability.Tracing`

Configures tracing. When tracing is enabled, the processor exports spans over OTLP and joins the Envoy trace through the inbound `traceparent` header.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `Observability.Tracing.Enabled`

Specifies whether the processor exports traces.

#### Values

- Default: `false`
- Data type: Boolean

### `Observability.Tracing.OTLP`

Configures OTLP export for traces.

- `Endpoint`: The OTLP collector address as `<host>:<port>`, without a URL scheme. Consul rejects a full URL.
- `Insecure`: Sends OTLP without TLS when `true`. Use only in non-production environments.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `Observability.Tracing.SampleRatio`

Specifies the fraction of requests to trace.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Number from `0` to `1`

## Examples

The following example configures an AI Inference Gateway named `travel-inference` to fail over across up to two tiers, mask email addresses in requests and responses, and export traces.

<Tabs>
<Tab heading="HCL" group="hcl">

```hcl
Kind = "inference-gateway"
Name = "travel-inference"
Processor {
  FailureMode = "closed"
}
Failover {
  RetryOn       = ["5xx", "connect-failure"]
  MaxTiers      = 2
  PerTryTimeout = "30s"
}
RequestTimeout = "10m"
PII {
  Scope         = "both"
  DefaultAction = "mask"
  Detectors = [
    {
      Name = "email"
    }
  ]
}
Observability {
  Tracing {
    Enabled = true
    OTLP {
      Endpoint = "otel-collector:4318"
    }
    SampleRatio = 1
  }
}
```

</Tab>
<Tab heading="JSON" group="json">

```json
{
  "Kind": "inference-gateway",
  "Name": "travel-inference",
  "Processor": {
    "FailureMode": "closed"
  },
  "Failover": {
    "RetryOn": ["5xx", "connect-failure"],
    "MaxTiers": 2,
    "PerTryTimeout": "30s"
  },
  "RequestTimeout": "10m",
  "PII": {
    "Scope": "both",
    "DefaultAction": "mask",
    "Detectors": [
      {
        "Name": "email"
      }
    ]
  },
  "Observability": {
    "Tracing": {
      "Enabled": true,
      "OTLP": {
        "Endpoint": "otel-collector:4318"
      },
      "SampleRatio": 1
    }
  }
}
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>
